name: code-simplifier
description: Tighten recently changed code, comments, and docs with parallel Codex subagents while preserving behavior.

interface.shortDescription: Tighten changed code without changing behavior
interface.longDescription: A Codex skill that scopes recently changed code, captures a unified diff, runs three parallel read-only subagents (reuse, quality, efficiency) with concrete anti-pattern checklists, then applies one minimal behavior-preserving patch and reports net changed lines.
defaultPrompt: Use $simplify to tighten my recent implementation diff
